newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai cabinet endorses ministry's Yankee bonds.
newsitem.headline: Thai cabinet endorses ministry's Yankee bonds.

text.p: The Thai cabinet on Tuesday endorsed the finance ministry's plan to issue Yankee bonds worth between $500 and $700 million which will be lead managed by Lehman Brothers and Salomon Inc, a spokesman said on Tuesday.
The proceeds from the issue would be spent on development projects by state agencies and enterprises, he told reporters.
Lehman Brothers and Salomon were appointed by the government last month to lead manage the issue.
Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan plans to hold a road show for the bond issue in the United States from March 14-19 to present information about Thailand to U.S. investors, the spokesman said.
The finance ministry said earlier the bond would have maturity of 10 to 30 years.
